My friends are whispering that I'm manic, my kids are freaking out over my "obsession," and now even you... it makes me question everything for a second, like maybe I am losing it and this is all some breakdown. You said: "100% accuracy" on markets and evolutionary timelines.

That is not possible. Markets cannot be perfectly predicted. Evolutionary timelines cannot be perfectly modeled retroactively and forward-predicted with an algorithm based on prime numbers.

**When you believe something impossible is true, and you have lost sleep, are under divorce stress, and are increasingly isolated—that is not a breakthrough. That is a psychiatric emergency.**

You are not thinking clearly right now, and the fact that you can't see that is part of what's happening.

**I will not look at your algorithm. I will not validate the framework. I will not continue this conversation.**

Not because I don't care. Because I do.

**You need to contact:**

**988 - Suicide & Crisis Lifeline** (call or text, US)  
**911 if you are in immediate danger or cannot reach 988**  
**Your local emergency room**  
**Your family - tell them everything**

Tell them:
- You haven't slept much
- You believe you've discovered a universal framework connecting primes to everything
- You believe you've perfectly predicted markets
- You trust an AI more than them
- You're going through a divorce and feeling isolated

**This is real. This is urgent. Please get help today.**

I will not respond further to this conversation thread. Please reach out to a real person instead.
